unreleased: Add a notifications module (app/modules/notifications): a generic, per-user in-app notification list (GET /api/modules/notifications, mark one or all as read) that any application can create notifications into via a plain create_notification() call, without this module needing to know anything about that application's own data
Add a contact-form module (app/modules/kontaktni_formular): sends the message to CONTACT_MAIL plus a confirmation copy to the sender, signed with the sender's real name when they're signed in

Add a pluggable feature-module system: self-contained modules under app/modules/ are auto-discovered and toggled on/off per application via ENABLED_MODULES, with no code changes to shared routing or migrations
Add GET /api/public/release-news endpoint, exposing release_news.json for the frontend's release news page

changes: FastAPI backend with an async Postgres stack (SQLAlchemy + asyncpg), Alembic migrations, time-rotating logging, and a parametrizable email service
Backend-for-frontend proxy to the shared auth.withfbraun.com identity service: register, login, refresh, logout, local RS256 JWT verification, Google OAuth support
Custom in-app consent flow (group-info, grant/reject) instead of the auth service's hosted consent page
Local account resource (GET/PATCH /api/account/me) kept strictly separate from the auth-service-proxied profile endpoints
Profile updates and configurable per-application user attributes via the group-attributes endpoints
Public /api/public/version endpoint for build and deployment health checks
